title: Adds a dissector for SANE (Scanner Access Now Easy).
description:
This change adds a dissector for the Scanner Access Now Easy (SANE)
network API described at
https://sane-project.gitlab.io/standard/net.html.

The protocol itself does not have much information about PDU lengths, so
the dissector has two main parts:

  * get_sane_pdu_length: reads each PDU, interpreting enough of the
    fields to determine the length of the message. Returns 0 if the
    message appears truncated (more frames needed), or if the response
    type cannot be determined

  * dissect_sane_internal: the main dissector routine. Assumes that
    enough bytes exist to dissect the message and throws exceptions
    if that is not the case.

I believe this is a fairly complete implementation of the control
protocol. The image data protocol (which is transmitted on a separate
port, similar to FTP passive mode) is not supported.

commits_data.title: Address code review comments
commits_data.message:
Address code review comments

* header field registrations no longer use designated initializers, for
  tool compatibility

* allow the user to specify a range of server ports as a preference. The
  dissector uses this range to determine whether a PDU is a request or
  response.

* move the handoff function after the registration function

* use val_to_str_const where no format specifier is used

* add missing static keywords to various functions

* add a comment to dissect_sane_string
